message.content:
High-neck thermal top in merino wool with a relaxed fit, color #2C3E50 (midnight blue), soft brushed fabric.
Wide-leg yoga trousers in a flowing drape cut, length ankle, color #7F8C8D (slate grey), technical stretch knit.
Minimalist leather slides with an open toe, color #95A5A6 (silver mist), smooth calfskin finish.

This ensemble balances the active needs of your morning yoga practice with the refined polish you want for your coffee date. The dark blue top and grey trousers create a grounding, sophisticated look that flatters your silhouette while allowing full freedom of movement. By keeping accessories minimal and choosing high-quality fabrics, the outfit seamlessly transitions from exercise to a cozy, stylish afternoon in the city without compromising on comfort or elegance.
